allowed_inputs.allowed_context: Opaque pair/cell/query identities, planned two-second delay and DAT/MFB reward type, the fixed0..3second movement-end grid, and all permitted one-second calibration/validation neural observations. allowed_inputs.allowed_context_policy: Identical planned-input-only view for participant and comparators; all one-second data may be used only under the frozen calibration/validation/refit recipe. allowed_inputs.neural_measurements: mainData1/2.mat contain micedats trial/session structures. Inspected IOChRmine_imaging reads rewAlgn.sigFilt_right_green as trial × cell × time; MainData separates GrC and CF populations and uses chronicGreen/chronicRed matches where available.

biological_unit: MainData obtains mouse names by splitting dirTable.DA_Dir and counts unique mice. Dated acquisition-path strings are retained provenance identifiers, not required local paths. Alt_Delay_Dir/WaterDir plus chronic registration link repeated conditions; group these under one animal.
case_definition: One biological animal with all selected registered paired sessions; trials/cells/pairs are nested scored observations and are not independent biological cases.
controls: Absolute-time source-mean and fixed piecewise-warp source-mean comparators on identical permitted inputs and target support.
Whole trials and the entire two-second neural condition remain held out; no target-response averaging or calibration.
Planned-input-only transfer: no query movement, licking, reward outcome or measured trigger timing; behavioral-independence claims are outside this task.
Equal-pair-within-mouse then equal-mouse aggregation, with all-trial/all-registered-cell support and recurrent-cell reporting.
